hidden.description:
sh-opacity/hidden
Purpose: Hide a layer while keeping its layout, transitions and interaction logic in place.

disabled.description:
sh-opacity/disabled
Purpose: Disabled controls. Always pair with disabled behaviour; never use to de-emphasise active content.

full.description:
sh-opacity/full
Purpose: Default visibility when no opacity reduction is needed.

strong.description:
sh-opacity/strong
Purpose: De-emphasised but readable: muted text, secondary imagery and non-essential visual content that stays active.

extra-soft.description:
sh-opacity/extra-soft
Purpose: Barely-there layer: hairline and bright borders, faint washes and subtle highlights on photos and dark or translucent surfaces.

soft.description:
sh-opacity/soft
Purpose: Light layer: scrims, image washes and translucent tints that sit behind content without hiding it.

extra-strong.description:
sh-opacity/extra-strong
Purpose: Heavy layer: dark overlays and near-solid scrims that should hide most of what sits behind them.
